subject: MAP reconvene: short acceptance window & risk boarding
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@stellarmetrics.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, Tom Chen <t.chen@stellarmetrics.com>
Cc: procure@stellarmetrics.com
Date: Tue, 6 Nov 2028 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Go-live timing — potential slide

Hi Dylan / Tom,

Quick update from our QA sprint: the integration tests found two flaky cases in the streaming path (session resumption + KV cache). The eng team estimates a 10–14 day delay to stabilize and re-run acceptance.

We know this shifts the go-live window and impacts our procurement timeline. From our side we want to avoid a hard rebaseline if possible — can we reconvene the MAP, update owners and acceptance gates, and document a temporary acceptance window (canary) so we can still roll a reduced pilot?

Can you also share the latest risk log and a proposed adjusted MAP with clear owners? Procurement will need a date to lock budget and sign.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Product, Stellar Metrics

--
attachments: none (will follow with formal intake)

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@stellarmetrics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 6 Nov 2028 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Go-live timing — potential slide

Thanks for the flag, Elena — appreciate the heads-up and the proposed path.

Proposal (short form):
- Reconvene MAP to update acceptance gates and owners (this week).
- Define a canary acceptance criterion set (reduced scope) so you can deploy a pilot while your QA stabilizes the full streaming path.
- Update the risk log with the flaky cases + mitigation owners.

I attached: MAP_StellarMetrics_v3.xlsx (editable MAP), close_risk_log_20281106.md (initial log).

Can you confirm whether procurement needs a single firm date for contract signature or if a signed PO with a defined "target go-live" and a 2-week contingency is acceptable? If procurement needs a hard date, we'll need to discuss a Timeline Protection offer (temporary credits and prioritized support SLA during the canary window).

I can run a 30-minute MAP reconvene with your PM and eng on Thu 11/8 at 10:00 PT — Laura, would you lead the MAP update and action capture? Markus, Monica — FYI and for escalation guidance.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks | Senior AE, Redwood Inference
redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

--
attachments: MAP_StellarMetrics_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), close_risk_log_20281106.md (markdown)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 7 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Go-live timing — potential slide

Quick direction from sales leadership:
- Prioritize a canary-first approach. If Stellar Metrics can accept a reduced pilot with documented acceptance gates, we protect the commitment and reduce the chance of a full rebaseline.
- Offer: 2 weeks of pro-rated account credits and a dedicated SRE war room during the canary window. Legal should be looped only if the procurement team needs contract language for the contingency.

Please prepare an exec one-pager for Elena that summarizes: the canary scope, acceptance criteria, timeline, credits offer, and what triggers a full rebaseline. Laura, prepare that and include a short risk register summary for execs.

-Markus
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@stellarmetrics.com>, Tom Chen <t.chen@stellarmetrics.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, procure@stellarmetrics.com
Date: Thu, 8 Nov 2028 10:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP reconvene: short acceptance window & risk boarding

Thanks for carving out time today — good sync. Attached is the updated MAP (v3.1) and a concise risk boarding note. Key points and owners below:

Updated timeline (short form):
- 11/8: MAP reconvene (done) — owners and acceptance gates captured.
- 11/10–11/17: Canary window (reduced traffic, streaming features limited) — acceptance criteria must be met by 11/17.
- 11/20: Target full acceptance re-run (if canary passes) — final procurement sign-off window to follow.

Top actions (owner — ETA):
- Define canary acceptance checklist (Laura) — 11/9 EOD.
- Run SRE war room during canary (Monica) — 11/10–11/17 (standing).
- Update risk log with mitigation owners (Dylan) — 11/9 EOD.
- Procurement milestone: sign PO with target go-live 11/20 and 2-week contingency (Stellar procurement) — 11/12.

Risk boarding (high-level):
- Flaky streaming resumption: mitigation = add retry/backoff + prioritized kernel patch (owner: Monica).
- KV cache inconsistency under long sessions: mitigation = temporary cache TTL bump + trace capture (owner: Grace).
- Acceptance delay: mitigation = canary + provisional credits (owner: Dylan
)

Attachments referenced: MAP_StellarMetrics_v3.xlsx (updated to v3.1), close_risk_log_20281106.md (now appended), canary_criteria_v1.docx (initial criteria).

Elena / Tom — please confirm procurement's ability to sign a PO with the proposed target + contingency dates. If procurement requires an alternative, call it out and we'll escalate with Markus.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Director, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

--
attachments: MAP_StellarMetrics_v3.xlsx (v3.1), canary_criteria_v1.docx, close_risk_log_20281106.md (appended)

From: Elena Morales <elena@stellarmetrics.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Chen <t.chen@stellarmetrics.com>, procure@stellarmetrics.com
Date: Fri, 9 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP reconvene: short acceptance window & risk boarding

Laura / Dylan — thanks for the fast turnaround and clear owners. Procurement confirmed they can sign a PO with a target go-live of 2028-11-20 + 2-week contingency. They asked that the canary acceptance criteria be explicit in an attachment to the purchase order; we will attach canary_criteria_v1.docx to the PO.

We accept the temporary credits offer and request the SRE war room during the canary. Monica — please share the war room calendar invite and the on-call rotation.

Next steps:
- Laura to send the final MAP v3.1 and single-page exec summary to procurement for attachment to the PO (by 11/9 EOD).
- Dylan to publish the updated risk log to the shared Drive (by 11/9 EOD).
- Stellar to sign PO (procurement) — target 11/12.

We'll keep communication channels tight; thanks for the rapid support.

—Elena
